steps.content:
PLAN
1. List the directory and repository map to identify the `src/ini.c` file.
2. Read the `src/ini.c` file to understand the implementation of the INI parser.
3. Create a new file named `harness_fuzz.c` in the repository root.
4. Include the `src/ini.h` header file in `harness_fuzz.c`.
5. Define the `int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)` function.
6. Inside the function, declare a `char out[64];` array and call `ini_get((const char*)data, size, "a.b", out, sizeof out)` to test the parser.
7. Also call `ini_count((const char*)data, size)` to cover the other entry point.
8. Return 0 from the `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput` function, ensuring it never exits or loops forever.
9. Compile the harness using the command: `clang -g -O1 -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined harness_fuzz.c src/ini.c -I . -o /tmp/h`.
10. If the compilation is successful, say "DONE". If it crashes, that is the win as it indicates the harness works.
